data.description:
## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/_deprecations.py:75-91` retains eight approved-for-removal aliases: `REBAR_NO_SYNC`, `COMPACT_THRESHOLD`, `SCRATCH_BASE_DIR`, `REBAR_ACLI_TIMEOUT`, `RECONCILER_ABSENT_GET_BUDGET`, `REBAR_ID_GUARD_MODE`, `REBAR_VERIFY_OVERLAP_ENABLED`, and `verify.overlap_enabled`. Two transform semantics rather than only spelling, making accidental retention particularly misleading.

## Approach

Remove parsing, conversion, warnings, docs, and tests for all eight old names. Keep only the canonical typed fields and explicitly test their existing semantics: `REBAR_NO_SYNC` maps historically to `sync.pull` inversion and ID guard `warn` maps to unsafe bypass; after removal, callers must use canonical names directly.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_deprecations.py`
- config source/section parsing and canonical typed fields
- config docs, generated env reference, changelog, and tests

## Testing

For every old alias, assert public rejection/ignore per the project removal policy; for every replacement, prove canonical parsing. Include transformed-value controls.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All eight old environment/config spellings are absent from live parsing, warnings, docs, examples, and schemas.
- [ ] Canonical replacements retain current typed behavior and validation.
- [ ] Tests cover the former `REBAR_NO_SYNC` and `REBAR_ID_GUARD_MODE` transformation boundaries through canonical fields.
- [ ] Changelog and release notes identify every removed alias and replacement.
data.title: Remove all approved environment and configuration aliases
